subject.title: [Bug]: 401 The API key format is incorrect

question: How should OpenClaw treat Volcengine Lite/Coding Plan UUID-like keys when a user selects a general Volcengine model such as `volcengine/deepseek-v3-2-251201`?
rationale: The source shows a real split between general and Coding Plan endpoints, but the safe product behavior depends on Volcengine's credential contract and whether OpenClaw should reroute, diagnose, or support the shared key on both surfaces.

options.title: Validate Lite routing first
options.body: Run a redacted live check against both Volcengine endpoints, then implement the narrow provider-owned routing or diagnostic behavior that matches the vendor result.

options.title: Keep Lite keys coding-only
options.body: If the key is only valid for Coding Plan, keep general models separate and add earlier setup/model-selection diagnostics for Lite-key users.

options.title: Support the key on both endpoints
options.body: If Volcengine expects the key to work on the general endpoint too, treat the 401 as a runtime/auth bug and fix the credential/header path with regression coverage.

recommendation.title: Validate Lite routing first
recommendation.body: Run a redacted live check against both Volcengine endpoints, then implement the narrow provider-owned routing or diagnostic behavior that matches the vendor result.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision crosses provider auth aliases, bundled plugin ownership, setup UX, and runtime compatibility where the history is strongest.
